meta.note: Descriptive cross-checks between independent datasets; no significance test (r values have no p-value). Burned means MCD64A1 burned share > 0 in the cell; only complete calendar years 2001-2025 are used.
meta.aiDisclosure: Generated by the SIGNO pipeline (pipeline/), code written with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code following the team's choices; values come only from the cited NASA and Hansen/UMD datasets.

design.text: Mann-Kendall test on yearly values with Sen's slope, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the tested cells of each variable. Pre-registered rules (autocorrelation, satellite drift) applied as written. V1 shuffles the years of every cell and reruns the whole procedure; V2 adds to the shuffled series a linear trend equal to the median |Sen slope| of the real significant cells.

variables.units: % of cell per year per decade

d1Drift.rule: If |r| >= 0.5 for a variable, its test ends in 2020 (like land surface temperature); otherwise it keeps 2001-2025 and 2021-2025 are flagged as satellite drift years.
